notes.title: November 27th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[olist]
Improved water bucket
Water will now come out when bucket faces below 90 degrees (it had to face straight down before to emit water)
[/olist]

notes.title: November 20th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[olist]
Added controller mapping to settings menu (you can now assign controllers to player 1 and 2)
Polished settings gameplay menu
Polished friend invite menu
Fixed some bugs related to opening steam overlay in main menu interfering with ingame UI
[/olist]

notes.title: November 15th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Added a button to use "Steam Remote Play together" from the menu.
2. Some debugging for remote play together
3. Some debugging for controllers not showing up correctly

notes.title: November 14th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[olist]
Added Steam controller support (you should now be able to play the game with offbrand controllers)
Added a controller connected heads up display (shows how many controllers are connected / if player 2 has joined the game)
Added Prompt to main menu that explains that two controllers are required to play co-op
Added 16:10 resolutions in settings resolutions dropdown
Fixed a bug where wrong glyphs would be displayed on UI if controllertype was not XBox / PS4
Fixed a bug where main menu navigation did not work
[/olist]

notes.title: November 9th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[olist]
Fixed a bug where opening Steam overlay in main menu would open main menu panel
[/olist]

notes.title: November 8th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[olist]
Fixed a bug where limb movement would be affected by frame rate
Fixed a bug where there was a possibility of having quests persist over scene changes leading to two quest log UI elements overlapping each other
[/olist]

notes.title: November 5th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[olist]
Fixed a bug where stars in main menu would not be displayed correctly
Fixed a bug where Steam Achievements Slowpoke and Sheperd could not be completed
[/olist]

notes.title: November 4th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[olist]
Fixed a bug where dead character limbs could activate respawns
Fixed a quest related bug in Bandit Camp 2
Fixed a bug where detaching attached objects (mushrooms) would not reset their constraints leading to them being able to roll off the playing plane
Removed wishlist button from main menu (since you bought the game already you probably won't have to wishlist it anymore)
Fixed a bug where Twitch integration user prompt was hiding behind Questlog
[/olist]

notes.title: Low FPS Hotfix
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug where running the game with low FPS (below 30) would break the player puppet when getting up
